'''Skeeris''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the shadow world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. The four-legged species had two clawed digits on their front legs and a long face with large teeth.[[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] killed several skeeris during the events of the [[Crisis on Umbara]].<ref name="TOR" />
